title: Ricardo E. Miranda
text:
PhD Candidate in Economics
Duke University

I am a PhD candidate at Duke University. My main research area is econometrics. My job market paper combines identification and inference results to develop a sharp, general test of instrument validity.
My secondary research applies quasi-experimental and structural methods to questions about human capital and health in middle-income countries.
Please contact me at: ricardo.e.miranda@duke.edu
